entry.title: Karl-Anthony Towns JOINS ELITE NBA HISTORY with 16th STRAIGHT DOUBLE-DOUBLE | November 22, 2026
entry.content:
Karl-Anthony Towns continues his DOMINANT start to the season, finishing with 30 POINTS, 13 REBOUNDS, 3 STEALS and 4 THREE-POINTERS. KAT recorded his 16th consecutive double-double to open the season, joining Nikola Jokić (20), Giannis Antetokounmpo (19) and Domantas Sabonis (16) as the only players since the 1981-82 season to accomplish this incredible feat. The last player to achieve this before this historic group was Moses Malone, who also opened the 1981-82 season with 16 straight double-doubles.

entry.title: Jamal Murray (45 PTS) & Nikola Jokić (37 PTS) Combine for 82 PTS in OT Thriller 👀
entry.content:
Jamal Murray and Nikola Jokić put on a HISTORIC show as the Denver Nuggets outlast the Chicago Bulls 151-145 in an overtime thriller! Murray exploded for 45 POINTS, 6 THREE-POINTERS, 5 REBOUNDS and 7 ASSISTS, while Jokić finished with an incredible 37 POINTS, 18 REBOUNDS and 11 ASSISTS for another dominant triple-double. Murray recorded his 9th career 45-point game, passing Alex English for the second-most in Nuggets franchise history, while Jokić extended his NBA record with his 17th career 35-point, 15-rebound, 10-assist game. Even more impressively, this marks the 8th time Murray has scored 40+ points while Jokić recorded a triple-double in the same game, the most by any duo in NBA history.

entry.title: Josh Giddey DROPS 22 ASSISTS in HISTORIC Bulls Performance | November 22, 2026
entry.content:
Josh Giddey puts on a HISTORIC performance, finishing with 23 POINTS, 14 REBOUNDS and a career-high 22 ASSISTS! Giddey becomes just the second player in Chicago Bulls franchise history to record at least 20 points, 20 assists and 10 rebounds in a game, joining Guy Rodgers, who accomplished the feat in 1966. His 22 assists are tied for the second-most in a single game in Bulls history and are the most by any NBA player this season. Giddey also becomes the first player in the NBA this season to record a 20-point, 20-assist game.

entry.title: Svi Mykhailiuk GOES OFF For CAREER-HIGH 39 PTS & 10 THREES vs. Mavericks 🔥 | November 22, 2026
entry.content:
Svi Mykhailiuk put on a SHOOTING CLINIC, exploding for a career-high 39 points, 5 rebounds, 3 assists, and 10 three-pointers against the Dallas Mavericks. Svi caught fire from beyond the arc, recording the 2nd-most made threes in a single game in Utah Jazz history, trailing only Bojan Bogdanović's 11. He was especially UNSTOPPABLE in the 4th quarter, pouring in 23 points on 7-of-9 shooting and 6-of-7 from three! Mykhailiuk helped spark an incredible 18-point comeback, bringing the Jazz back from an 18-point deficit to tie the game, but Dallas ultimately came away with the win.
